Read input: origen_199535.v · Open raw
module origen_199535(
    input clk,
    input rst,
    input move,
    input fire,
    input collision,
    input [10:0] inx,
    input [10:0] iny,
    output reg [10:0] ox,
    output reg [10:0] oy
);

localparam S0 = 1'b0, S1 = 1'b1;
reg state;

initial begin
    state = S0;
    ox = 11'd1050;
    oy = 11'd128;
end

always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
    if (rst) begin
        state <= S0;
        ox <= 11'd1050;
        oy <= 11'd128;
    end
    else begin
        case (state)
            S0: begin
                if (fire) begin
                    ox <= inx;
                    oy <= iny;
                    state <= S1;
                end
                else begin
                    ox <= 11'd1050;
                    oy <= 11'd128;
                end
            end
            S1: begin
                if (move) begin
                    oy <= oy - 11'd8;
                end
                if (collision || oy < 11'd247) begin
                    state <= S0;
                end
            end
        endcase
    end
end

endmodule
